::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 18th [1868?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Iowa; MsL/Y56va
:::

My dear [Mrs Valentine](people/person_1437.qmd),
I have got my Armada story home, and on looking over it, I think it will answer your purpose very well, but I must copy it out again to take out the real names and to improve it. I suppose about 70 or 80pp of the size of the specimen I send which is the first chapter.[^1]

Please return it, when you have glanced over it, and tell me if it will do. The scenery is real, but I have changed the names and transposed that of the river - the Yealm. I think the boat would make a pretty illustration.

How ingeniously the young ladies playing at games have been varied in the [Home Book](other_books/otherbook_528.qmd)!

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: It sounds as if Valentine had solicited a contribution to one of the annuals she edited for Warne.
